title: Toward Understanding Bias Correlations for Mitigation in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using False Negative/Positive Equality Difference (FNED/FPED) in toxicity detection across male and female groups, and using Mean Average Cosine (MAC) distance to measure bias components in word embeddings with gender-specific defining word sets.

Evaluated using False Negative/Positive Equality Difference (FNED/FPED) in toxicity detection across black and white demographic groups, and using Mean Average Cosine (MAC) distance to quantify bias in word embeddings using race-associated lexicons.

Evaluated using False Negative/Positive Equality Difference (FNED/FPED) in toxicity detection across Christian, Jewish, and Muslim groups, and using Mean Average Cosine (MAC) distance to quantify bias in word embeddings using religion-associated lexicons.
